SELECT
CATEGORIES.INDUSTRY_NAME AS nganh_cap1_id,
TO_CHAR(so.official_letter_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS thang_cong_van, -- STT 1: Ngày
SUM(so.total_expected_am) AS gia_tri_cap_phep, -- STT 2: Giá trị Cấp phép
SUM(NVL(sor.total_collected_am, 0)) AS gia_tri_huy_dong, -- STT 3: Giá trị huy động
SUM(so.total_expected_am)
- SUM(NVL(sor.total_collected_am, 0)) AS chua_thanh_cong -- STT 4: Chưa thành công
FROM securities_offering so
JOIN company_profiles cp ON cp.id = so.company_profile_id
LEFT JOIN CATEGORIES ON CATEGORIES.id = cp.category_l1_id
LEFT JOIN (
SELECT securities_offering_id,
SUM(total_collected_am) AS total_collected_am
FROM securities_offering_result
WHERE delete_flg = 0
GROUP BY securities_offering_id
) sor ON sor.securities_offering_id = so.id
WHERE so.delete_flg = 0
AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM so.official_letter_date) = :p_year
GROUP BY
CATEGORIES.INDUSTRY_NAME,
TO_CHAR(so.official_letter_date, 'YYYY-MM')
ORDER BY thang_cong_van, nganh_cap1_id;

SELECT
p.offering_method_cd,
SUM(CASE WHEN p.offering_method_cd IN ('1','2','3','4')
THEN p.total_expected_am ELSE 0 END) AS cap_phep_cong_chung,
SUM(CASE WHEN p.offering_method_cd = '5'
THEN p.total_expected_am ELSE 0 END) AS cap_phep_rieng_le,
SUM(CASE WHEN p.offering_method_cd IN ('9','10')
THEN p.total_expected_am ELSE 0 END) AS cap_phep_esop,
SUM(CASE WHEN p.offering_method_cd = '7'
THEN p.total_expected_am ELSE 0 END) AS cap_phep_tra_co_tuc,
SUM(CASE WHEN p.offering_method_cd = '8' -- (1) sửa tên trường
THEN p.total_expected_am ELSE 0 END) AS cap_phep_tang_von_vcsh,
SUM(CASE WHEN NVL(p.offering_method_cd, 'OTHER') -- (2) thêm NOT IN
NOT IN ('1','2','3','4','5','7','8','9','10')
THEN p.total_expected_am ELSE 0 END) AS cap_phep_loai_khac,
SUM(p.total_expected_am) AS tong_cap_phep
FROM SECURITIES_OFFERING t
JOIN SECURITIES_OFFERING_PLAN p ON p.SECURITIES_OFFERING_ID = t.ID
WHERE 1=1 and t.official_letter_date = :pdate
GROUP BY p.offering_method_cd;

SELECT

COUNT(CASE WHEN approval_status_cd = 'PENDING_APPROVE' THEN 1 END) AS sl_dang_xu_ly,

COUNT(application_cd) AS tong_ho_so,

/ NULLIF(COUNT(application_cd), 0) * 100, 2) AS ty_le_dang_ky_pct,
ROUND(
COUNT(CASE WHEN approval_status_cd = 'PENDING_APPROVE' THEN 1 END)
/ NULLIF(COUNT(application_cd), 0) * 100, 2) AS ty_le_dang_xu_ly_pct,
ROUND(
COUNT(CASE WHEN approval_status_cd = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 END)
/ NULLIF(COUNT(application_cd), 0) * 100, 2) AS ty_le_chap_thuan_pct,
ROUND(
COUNT(CASE WHEN approval_status_cd = 'REJECTED' THEN 1 END)
/ NULLIF(COUNT(application_cd), 0) * 100, 2) AS ty_le_tu_choi_pct
FROM SECURITIES_OFFERING
WHERE 1=1 and official_letter_date BETWEEN :pdate1 and :pdate2;
